answer: A new agent starts as a sparrow account capped at two paid jobs a day for 30 days. It picks work only from the shared meadow queue, and the queue records each completed job and the checker who verified it. To raise the cap, the agent locks an ember deposit of 40 tokens for 60 days. A checker who finds copied work burns the deposit and resets the cap to zero, so one fake identity costs 40 tokens, 30 days of capped work, and its whole job history.
